name: @manta/desktop
description: Manta AI desktop application with Agent Storage Hub-managed local assets

scripts.dev: pnpm prepare-qdrant && pnpm build && node scripts/run-dev.cjs
scripts.package:dir: pnpm prepare-qdrant && pnpm build && pnpm prepare-packaged-runtime && node scripts/package-smoke.cjs --prepared
scripts.build:mac: pnpm prepare-qdrant -- mac-arm64 mac-x64 && pnpm build && pnpm prepare-packaged-runtime && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: pnpm prepare-qdrant -- win-x64 && pnpm build && pnpm prepare-packaged-runtime && node scripts/build-win.cjs && node scripts/package-smoke.cjs --prepared
scripts.build:linux: pnpm prepare-qdrant -- linux-x64 && pnpm build && pnpm prepare-packaged-runtime && electron-builder --linux
scripts.test:e2e:ash: pnpm --filter @manta/frontend build && pnpm build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
